must_show: hull 72.0 m (screw X -36.0 to the rounded bow X +36.0), 7.6 m beam, casing top 1.7 m amidships, keel -6.4
the casing on the hull's back from the knuckle line (z -0.76, X -21.1 .. 33.3, ends upright) to a flat top about 5 m wide, sloped sides; a row of free-flood holes low on it X -19.5 .. 31

sail X 9.8 .. 20.5, top 7.43 m: raked after edge (X 10.3 at z 4), front near upright and half-round (X 20.4 at z 4), top edge rounded; the window row under the top X 17.3 .. 18.65, the seam and the bridge recess, the sail planes on its forward half (X 17.8 .. 20.4 at z 4.69, 2.2 m out), ladder rungs on the side
the rounded bow of the boat as built (not the Amethyste's blunt sonar bow), torpedo shutters X 33.8
cruciform stern X -33.4 .. -30.2: upper rudder to 1.25, lower to -6.6, stern planes 4.0 m out on the shaft line z -2.8, hinge slots; the shaft fairing aft to the five-bladed screw at X -35.65

weld seams round the pressure hull every 3.6 m; hatches X -14, 7, 23.5 and the loading hatch X 28; cleats; capstan X 30; the safety track; plain black painted steel (no tiles); no numbers or markings; team colour only as small strips
